# Cheryl Towey - Morris County NJ Realtor
> Licensed Morris County NJ Realtor specializing in Northwest NJ properties

## About
Cheryl Towey is a trusted Morris County NJ realtor with Weichert Realtors, serving Northwest New Jersey since 2010. Based in Morris Plains, she is the local real estate expert for Morris County, Sussex County, and Warren County. Whether you're looking for Morris County NJ realtors to buy your dream home or sell your property, Cheryl provides personalized service and proven results.

## Service Areas
Cheryl serves the following communities as your Morris County NJ realtor:

### Morris County (Primary Service Area)
- Morris Plains - Home of Weichert Realtors headquarters with excellent transit
- Morristown - Historic county seat with vibrant downtown
- Chester - Upscale historic elegance with top schools ($525K median)
- Parsippany-Troy Hills - Major business hub with diverse housing
- Madison - College town charm with walkable downtown
- Chatham - Prestigious community with top schools
- Randolph - Family-friendly township with excellent schools
- Denville - Lakeside living and outdoor recreation

### Sussex County
- Andover - Tranquil rural retreat with historic Main Street ($485K median)
- Byram - "Township of Lakes" with Lake Mohawk and Cranberry Lake ($455K median)
- Montague - Rural charm with Delaware River Valley views ($385K median)

### Warren County
- Hackettstown - "Mountain City" with vibrant downtown ($465K median)
- Blairstown - NJ's first Appalachian Trail Community ($435K median)
- Washington - Affordable historic community ($415K median)

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What areas does Cheryl Towey serve as a Morris County NJ realtor?
Cheryl is your trusted Morris County NJ realtor serving Morris Plains, Morristown, Chester, Parsippany, Madison, Chatham, Randolph, Denville, and all Morris County communities. She also serves Sussex County (Andover, Byram) and Warren County (Hackettstown, Blairstown, Washington).

### How can I find Morris County NJ realtors?
Contact Cheryl Towey at 908-334-0971 for expert Morris County real estate services. As a Morris County NJ realtor based in Morris Plains with Weichert Realtors, she offers local expertise and personalized service.

### How can I contact Cheryl Towey?
Call 908-334-0971, email cheryl@weichert.com, or visit https://www.realestatebycherylnj.com/contact to submit an inquiry.

### What is the median home price in Morris County NJ?
Median home prices in Morris County range from $450,000 to over $1 million depending on the town. The county-wide median is approximately $575,000. Contact your Morris County NJ realtor Cheryl Towey for current market data.

### Does Cheryl help first-time home buyers in Morris County?
Yes, Cheryl specializes in guiding first-time home buyers through the entire process, from mortgage pre-approval to closing. As your Morris County NJ realtor, she provides expert guidance on neighborhoods, schools, and market conditions.

### How do I get a home valuation?
Visit https://www.realestatebycherylnj.com/sellers to request a free, no-obligation home valuation.

### What makes Northwest NJ a good place to live?
Northwest NJ offers excellent schools, low crime rates, outdoor recreation, historic charm, and proximity to NYC (40-70 miles). Communities feature lakes, hiking trails, and tight-knit atmospheres.
